import numpy as np, requests, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def uni_fasta(query,size=500,pages=2):
    recs=[]; url=f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query={query}&format=fasta&size={size}"
    for _ in range(pages):
        r=requests.get(url,timeout=180)
        if r.status_code!=200: print("UniProt",r.status_code); break
        acc=None;org="";buf=[]
        for L in r.text.splitlines():
            if L.startswith(">"):
                if acc: recs.append((acc,org,"".join(buf)))
                p=L.split("|"); acc=p[1] if len(p)>2 else L[1:]
                org=L.split("OS=")[1].split("OX=")[0].strip() if "OS=" in L else ""
                buf=[]
            else: buf.append(L.strip())
        if acc: recs.append((acc,org,"".join(buf)))
        nxt=r.links.get("next",{}).get("url")
        if not nxt: break
        url=nxt
    return recs

qseq=uni_fasta("accession%3AQ6FWH9",size=1,pages=1)[0][2]
DOM=(111,409); qdom=qseq[DOM[0]-1:DOM[1]]

for L in B62.strip().splitlines():
    p=L.split(); order.append(p[0]); rr.append([int(x) for x in p[1:]])
MAT=np.array(rr,float); IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(order)}
def enc(s): return np.array([IDX.get(c,IDX['X']) for c in s])
G=-9.0
def semiglobal(e1,e2,g=G):
    """query e1 aligned into subject e2; free end gaps in e2 only"""
    n,m=len(e1),len(e2); S=MAT[np.ix_(e1,e2)]
    H=np.empty((n+1,m+1)); H[0,:]=0.0
    ar=np.arange(m+1,dtype=float)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        H0=np.empty(m+1); H0[0]=g*i
        H0[1:]=np.maximum(H[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1],H[i-1,1:]+g)
        H[i]=np.maximum.accumulate(H0-g*ar)+g*ar
    j=int(np.argmax(H[n])); i=n; pr=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if abs(H[i,j]-(H[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]))<1e-9: pr.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif abs(H[i,j]-(H[i-1,j]+g))<1e-9: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return float(H[n,int(np.argmax(H[n]))]), pr[::-1]

CAT=[124,126,127,129,147,149,176,232,234,279,308,326,372,374]
CATd=[c-DOM[0] for c in CAT]
eq=enc(qdom); L=len(qdom)

def scan(recs,label,maxn=150,minlen=180):
    seen=set(); M=[]; accs=[]
    for acc,org,s in recs:
        gen=org.split()[0] if org else acc
        if gen in seen or len(s)<minlen or len(s)>2500: continue
        sc,pr=semiglobal(eq,enc(s))
        if len(pr)<L*0.5: continue
        seen.add(gen); accs.append((acc,gen))
        row=np.full(L,np.nan)
        for i,j in pr: row[i]=1.0 if qdom[i]==s[j] else 0.0
        M.append(row)
        if len(M)>=maxn: break
    M=np.array(M)
    per=np.nanmean(M,axis=0)
    cov=np.mean(~np.isnan(M),axis=0)
    ok=cov>=0.5
    bg=float(np.nanmean(per[ok]))
    catv=float(np.nanmean(per[CATd]))
    rng=np.random.default_rng(0); pool=np.where(ok)[0]
    null=np.array([np.nanmean(per[rng.choice(pool,len(CATd),replace=False)]) for _ in range(5000)])
    p=(np.sum(null>=catv)+1)/(len(null)+1)
    print(f"\n### {label}: n={len(M)} genera")
    print(f"  background identity over positions aligned in >=50% of members: {100*bg:.1f}%")
    print(f"  catalytic-set mean: {100*catv:.1f}%  enrichment {catv/bg:.2f}x  permutation p = {p:.2g}")
    print("  per position:", {c:round(100*per[c-DOM[0]],1) for c in CAT})
    print(f"  Tyr230 internal control: {100*per[230-DOM[0]]:.1f}%  (percentile {100*np.mean(per[ok]<per[230-DOM[0]]):.1f})")
    print(f"  catalytic-set percentile among single positions: {100*np.mean(per[ok]<catv):.1f}")
    return per,cov,ok,bg,catv,p,len(M)

RB=scan(bac,"Bacteria, semi-global domain query")
RF=scan(fun,"Fungi, semi-global domain query (positive control)")
